negative_reviews.author: daisy mcphaze
negative_reviews.text: Food was lovely. Great sushi, katsu curry etc. Service was a let down. Very slow on a quiet early evening. Drinks and edamame (which we were told was to snack on while we waited) didn't arrive until our meal was served (after 20 mins). 2 of our party of 4 had their food delivered first, waited another 5 minutes before another was served and then I waited another 5-10 minutes for mine. I might expect this from wagamamas, but it was ultimately quite frustrating at the start.

negative_reviews.author: Br7u Ffitch
negative_reviews.text: The food was alright , when we went they were handing out free dumplings so we ordered them to no where did it say they we couldn't use it with our £5 deal not the app and not on the card . Nor did the person taking our order tell us ending up paying more than we wanted as a student no ones to do that . Please tell customers when they can not do something also took 20 mins to get the bill after trying to get the attention of the workers bear in mind although it was lunch only 5 tables where in and all was accounted for .
